What happens when you meet the right person at the right time under the right context? We interview entrepreneurs, creatives, and professionals doing great work in their fields and communities who have something to teach us. Every good person should meet the people below.

Episode 4

Meka Egwuekwe

CodeCrew: Computer Science and AI Education as an Access Pathway

Episode coming soon

Meka Egwuekwe explains how CodeCrew uses computer science and AI education to connect Memphis kids and adults with access, opportunity, and lasting career pathways. The conversation covers CodeCrew's founding, student success stories, its role in Tennessee computer science policy, and the organization's economic impact and plans for an AI-driven future.
